solution.quick: The minute hand is ahead of the hour hand by 3 minutes at 6:36 pm (Option C).
solution.concept: Clock Relative Motion: Minute hand gains 55 minute spaces in 60 minutes over hour hand.

3. The minute hand gains 55 minute spaces every 60 minutes (speed = 55/60 = 11/12 spaces per minute).
4. Time required = 33 / (11/12) = 33 * (12/11) = 3 * 12 = 36 minutes.
5. Therefore, the exact time is 6:36 pm.

Hence, Option C (6:36 pm) is the correct answer.
